You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4063-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.

678-4247-5865.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.

2595-4694-7306-8249.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4694-7306-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-4694-7306-8249.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

579-3755-4824.description:

Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.

2021-2060-5902-6260.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2020-2493.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1987-2020-2493.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

579-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.
579-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {6} due to Mana Reflection.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
579-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 2 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

2099-6972-7158.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1636-4023-5330-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-4023-5330-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

When Emptiness enters, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emptiness, adding {W}.
Resolve Emptiness's evoke trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it's no longer on the battlefield.
Resolve Emptiness's first trigger, returning Samwise the Stouthearted from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters, it triggers, returning Emptiness from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted, adding {W}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

539-2098-5531.description:
Play Vesuva, and choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Lumra.
Put Vesuva into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuva's ETB ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
As Vesuva enters the battlefield, choose to have it become a copy of Lumra.
Repeat from step 2.

1190-1517-2845-3556.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has exactly two lore counters on it.
1190-1517-2845-3556.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on it, and then causing you to copy any instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn and sacrifice The Mirari Conjecture.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Biblioplex Assistant.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Biblioplex Assistant.
When Biblioplex Assistant enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Biblioplex Assistant.
Quintorius Kand and The Mirari Conjecture trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the The Mirari Conjecture trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 4.

Mist-Syndicate Naga and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Mist-Syndicate Naga or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.

Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Mist-Syndicate Naga from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mist-Syndicate Naga's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mist-Syndicate Naga onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Decoction Module.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

Resolve Felidar Retreat's trigger, creating a 2/2 Cat Beast creature token.
The Cat Beast token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Quirion Sentinel to your hand.
